See https://variantdesign.xyz/submit. You can paste the generated draft here, or fill the fields below. Nothing is accepted automatically.

投稿及附件会公开。请只提供你有权授权且愿意公开的信息。可以在本编辑器上传图片或视频，然后将 GitHub 生成的地址填入媒体字段；附件一经上传即存放在 GitHub。
Submissions and attachments are public. Include only information you can authorize and want public. Upload a local image/video in this editor, then put GitHub’s generated URL in the media field; attaching uploads the file to GitHub immediately.

**作品 / Work**
- 名称 / Title:
- 原始 HTTPS 链接 / Original HTTPS URL:
- 类别 / Category (landing, product, flow, practice):
- 作品说明 / Notes:

**媒体 / Media**
- 图片或视频 / Image or video:
- 媒体 HTTPS 地址 / Media HTTPS URL:
- 视频封面 HTTPS 地址 / Video poster HTTPS URL:
- 画面描述（替代文本）/ Visual description (alt text):

**署名与授权 / Credit and permission**
- 署名名称和作者主页 / Credit name and author URL:
- 授权人或团队 / Grantor or team:
- 你有权授权的依据 / Why you hold the rights:
- 授权日期 / Permission date:
- 撤下方式（例如回复本 Issue 或提交撤下请求）/ Withdrawal method (e.g. reply here or open a takedown request):
- [ ] 我有权允许上述媒体在本站作品流和详情页展示，并知道可以随时撤回。仅授权本站展示，不授予下载、复用、MCP、再分发或商业使用权限。 / I can permit the media on this site’s feed and detail pages and can withdraw at any time. Display here only; no download, reuse, MCP, redistribution or commercial-use rights.

**审核 / Review (maintainers)**
Verify the original source, authorship/authority, permission, media dimensions/format, attribution and alt text. Save the grant record URL, reviewer/date, editorial notes and translation status through code review. A submitted checkbox alone is not proof of ownership.
